summary: Backend end-to-end tests for GLC Zone CRM+ERP. 38/38 tests passed covering auth, dashboard, CRM (leads/customers/deals/quotations), sales (orders/invoices/payments), inventory, purchase (with PO->stock), delivery, HR (attendance/leaves/payroll), finance (accounts/journal/GST/P&L/expenses), projects/tasks, support tickets, documents, notifications, audit, settings and users. Auth 401 checks verified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1495 lines; consider splitting per module (CRM/Sales/Inventory/Purchase/HR/Finance/etc.) for maintainability (>700 line rule).

PUT /purchase-orders/{pid}, /leaves/{lid}, /expenses/{eid}, /tasks/{tid}, /projects/{pid}, /deliveries/{did}, /settings/company, /notifications/read-all accept unvalidated Dict[str, Any] — add Pydantic partial-update models to guard against arbitrary field writes (e.g. clients could overwrite id/createdAt).
POST /journal does not validate that referenced accountId values exist in db.accounts.
PUT /purchase-orders receiving flow does not guard against double-receiving (calling with status=RECEIVED twice would increment stock twice). Recommend checking previous status before incrementing.
GET /reports/gst returns invoices list which may be large; consider paginating or returning only summary + top N.
Payroll generate uses e.get('salary',0); missing PF/ESI caps and tax rules — acceptable for demo but noted.
seed_data_creation: None - relied on server startup seed which populated users, products (>=14), leads (>=8), customers, deals, orders, employees, accounts, tickets, projects, tasks, etc. Verified via list endpoints.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py covers all 13 modules with pytest classes. QuoteItem model requires field 'name' (not 'productName'). Idempotent flows tested: invoice generation, payroll (same month returns generated=0), PO stock increment on RECEIVED. Frontend testing pending — separate iteration.
